properties.note: cyclobutene, C2v-like planar ring, C3-C4 = 1.569 A, 0 imaginary frequencies

Conrotatory 4-pi electrocyclic TS. Key distances (map order): C3-C4 2.143 A (breaking, from 1.542 in the reactant), C1-C2 1.379 A (double -> single), C1-C4 and C2-C3 1.429 A (forming double bonds). One imaginary mode -728.4 cm^-1. Independent reproduction of the ts_prepare saddle (ts/ts_0001) at the same energy.

s-cis-1,3-butadiene, the direct IRC product (C1-C2-C3-C4 dihedral -11.6 deg): with the reactant atom map, C3-C4 is now 3.09 A (broken), C1-C4 and C2-C3 are 1.341 A (double) and C1-C2 1.470 A (single). 0 imaginary frequencies. The s-trans rotamer is 3.3 kcal/mol lower (p_butadiene/p_g16_opt_freq.log, E=-155.892148996 Ha).

edges.bond_change_comment: Bond-order changes over the step in the given map (reactant [CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH2:4]1): C3-C4 sigma bond cleaved, C1-C2 pi bond becomes single, C1-C4 and C2-C3 become double bonds (the two new pi bonds of the diene).
